title: Make a Toy
blurb: Four pieces of a custom node from editor to method.

chapters.title: Hello
chapters.text: Every custom toy has four LEGO pieces: data struct, auth card, draw node, and run method. Grove glues them with numbers.
chapters.deep: Split across assemblies: unmanaged payload and enums in data or runtime, Grove Execution Auth or Data Auth in Authoring, Grove Execution Node in Editor, static Execute Node method in runtime.

chapters.title: Four pieces
chapters.text: Data holds Speed. Auth serializes it. Draw node is what you see in Graph Toolkit. Run method is the static C sharp with the attribute.
chapters.deep: Auth Node Type returns your enum int. Init writes blob fields via Blob Remap Builder. Editor Init copies inspector fields onto auth during import.

chapters.title: Wire
chapters.text: Importer copies draw fields into auth. Bake packs header plus payload. Use With Graph scopes the node to your map type.
chapters.deep: Create Node on auth allocates header and payload in the graph blob. Instance overrides patch serializable fields per entity before Create. Add Dependencies tracks extra assets.

chapters.title: Play
chapters.text: At play, Type hits your case in the door book. Method gets payload, Grove Context, and your context by ref. Then it mutates the world.
chapters.deep: Attribute Execute Node type id must match baked Type. Signature is public or internal static, non-generic outer type, ref context. Optional typed input for context and block nodes.
